_comment: The one list of case studies. Add a case here, then run: python3 tools/build_cases.py. It rewrites the index cards in Case_Studies.html and the More cases list in app.js. Newest first within each topic.

cases.title: Why is our profit lower than the report says?
cases.line: The weekly profit report was missing real costs. Checking it against Xero found them.

cases.title: Are we paying anyone twice?
cases.line: A change in how providers were paid overlapped with the old way. Cross-checking the exports found who, and how much.

cases.title: Reconciliation takes up someone's whole month
cases.line: 15,000 lines a month across nine payment types, with no shared ID. Now most of it matches itself.
cases.number: A month, down to Monday morning

cases.title: Our tools never agree on what's booked
cases.line: Bookings lived in several tools that disagreed. Now one record holds the truth and every tool shows it.

cases.title: Salespeople keep sending wrong quotes
cases.line: Pricing got complicated and wrong quotes went out. Now the screen only offers the right next step.
cases.number: Four steps, nothing that breaks a quote

cases.title: We only find out something broke when someone happens to look
cases.line: The day after launch, a leftover from the old system put a wrong total on a test booking. Now the system watches itself.
cases.number: Caught in a test, not by a customer

cases.title: Can we switch systems without stopping the business?
cases.line: The whole booking system moved over in one evening, with a way back at every step and the team trained first.

cases.title: Matchday payroll eats a whole morning after every game
cases.line: Shift forms, a posted rota and a morning of checking. Now it runs overnight and flags only what needs a person.

cases.title: Supplier invoices eat hours of data entry
cases.line: Five cafés, five Xero ledgers, bills sent across by hand every week. Now each one routes itself.
